user.title: Set up Nova
user.description:
Enter a key for each AI provider you want to use, your Ollama address, or both. Every field is optional, but at least one is needed. Nova checks each one.

Saved keys found: {saved}. Leave a field blank to keep its saved key.

roles.title: Choose a provider for each role
roles.description:
Pick which provider does each job. Only providers that passed the check are listed.

Saved keys that did not work and were left out: {failed}.

data_description.conversation: Talks to you and controls your home.
data_description.classifier: Decides if a home event matters. Runs often.
data_description.reasoning: Decides what to do about an event, and writes briefings. Runs often.
data_description.camera_reasoning: Judges a camera scene from the vision description.
data_description.vision: Describes camera pictures. Choose Not now to set this up later.

models.title: Choose a model for each role
models.description: Nova tests each model when you submit. Classifier and reasoning run often, so on a paid provider pick a small, cheap model for them. To change a provider, start setup again: these screens have no back button.

data_description.vision_model: Leave empty to set up vision later.

error.need_llm: Enter at least one key or an Ollama address.
error.no_working_provider: No working provider yet: enter a key or an Ollama address.
error.cannot_connect: The check could not complete. Try again in a moment, and check the address if this is Ollama.
error.model_required: Choose a model for this role.
error.model_no_pictures: This model could not read a test picture.
error.model_not_found: This provider does not offer that model.
error.model_access_denied: Your key cannot use this model.
error.test_incomplete: The test could not complete. Try again.
error.test_failed: The test failed. The provider's reason is in Home Assistant's log.
error.secrets_write_failed: Nova could not save the keys to secrets.yaml. Check the file can be written, then try again.
error.config_write_failed: Nova could not save your choices to its config file. Check the nova folder can be written, then try again.

abort.import_failed: Found a Nova config but no usable LLM (no API key and no local endpoint).
abort.already_in_progress: Nova setup is already open in another window.
abort.updated: Nova Voice ID found. Its address is saved in Nova.
abort.no_nova_entry: Nova Voice ID was found, but Nova isn't set up yet. Set up Nova first, then restart the Nova Voice ID app.
abort.invalid_discovery_info: Nova Voice ID sent an address Nova can't use. Paste the address from the app's log into Nova's Voice ID card instead.

menu_options.core: Core: how Nova addresses you, its directive and conversation model
menu_options.routing: Rooms and speakers: bedrooms, broadcast speakers and phone alerts
menu_options.observer: Observer: noticing what happens at home, models and quiet hours
menu_options.credentials: Credentials: API keys for each provider
menu_options.email: Email: read only inbox, password kept in secrets.yaml

core.title: Nova core settings
core.description: How Nova addresses you, the directive it follows and the model it talks with.

data.directive: Your own directive (optional, replaces the one above)
data.use_hass_api: Let Nova control the home (lights, heating, locks and more)

routing.title: Nova rooms and speakers
routing.description: Choose the bedroom areas used to tell when the house is asleep, the speaker group for broadcasts and the notify service for your phone.

data.bedroom_areas: Bedrooms (used to tell when people are asleep in quiet hours)
data.ground_floor_areas: Ground floor areas (for night time intrusion alerts)
data.broadcast_group: Broadcast speakers (usually the speaker group for the whole home)

data_description.bedroom_areas: During quiet hours, presence in any of these rooms switches on sleep mode.
data_description.ground_floor_areas: At night Nova only alerts on motion when one of these areas has an outside door or window open. Leave empty to watch every floor.
data_description.broadcast_group: Critical and urgent announcements play here.
data_description.notify_service: Used when you are out or asleep.

observer.title: Nova — Observer Mode
observer.description: proactive awareness. Nova watches your home and speaks up when something's worth noting. Provider API keys (Gemini included) are set in Configure → Credentials, not here.

credentials.title: Nova — Credentials
credentials.description: One dedicated API key per provider — Groq, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint, and an optional Bearer key for a protected Ollama endpoint. Stored only in Home Assistant's secrets.yaml, never in the panel config, and never shown back here. Status: {status}. Leaving a field blank makes no change to that provider's stored key. Main Agent provider is currently: {active}.

data.ollama_credential: Ollama Bearer key (optional — only for a protected endpoint)
data.confirm_delete_active: Yes, I understand clearing the Main Agent's current provider's key will disable it until a new key is set or the provider is changed

identity.title: Nova identity
identity.description: Lets Nova recognise who is speaking and respond to that person. No special hardware is needed: it uses who is home and, if set up, camera face recognition. Voice fingerprints are the most accurate but need a local GPU, so they start switched off.

data.identity_min_confidence: How sure Nova must be before naming a person
data.voice_recognition_source: Voice recognition source (an entity from a speaker recognition service, such as binary_sensor.*_voice)
data.voice_recognition_auto_enroll: Suggest voices to enrol as people speak

data_description.identity_enabled: Uses who is home and recent camera face matches. No GPU needed.
data_description.identity_voice_fingerprint: Keep off unless a GPU server runs a voice ID model.
data_description.identity_min_confidence: Higher = more careful: when unsure, Nova names nobody.

email.title: Nova — Email
email.description: Read-only inbox access. The IMAP password is read from Home Assistant's secrets.yaml — add it there under the key below (default nova_imap_password); it is never stored in the panel config.

error.credential_set_and_clear: For each provider, either enter a new key or tick "clear" — not both.
error.confirm_required_for_active_provider: Clearing the Main Agent's current provider's key needs the confirmation box ticked, so it can't happen by a stray click.

llm_unavailable.title: Nova reasoning backend unavailable
llm_unavailable.description:
Nova couldn't reach its reasoning model, so it's running in limited mode — device control, status, and scenes still work. Reason: {detail}

Open the Nova panel → Settings and check your provider, model, and API key. If your provider retired the model, re-select it from the list. This notice clears automatically once reasoning is working again.

credential_migration_ambiguous.title: Nova: a saved credential needs to be assigned to a provider
credential_migration_ambiguous.description: Nova found a shared credential from before separate provider credentials existed, but couldn't tell which provider it belongs to (no saved provider, and the key's shape didn't match a known provider). Nothing was changed or deleted — the old credential still works. To finish migrating it, open Settings → Devices & Services → Nova → Configure → Credentials and enter it under the correct provider. This notice clears automatically once that's done.

voice_setup_step_addons.title: Nova is setting up voice
voice_setup_step_addons.description: Step {step} of {total}: installing and starting the Piper, Whisper and openWakeWord add-ons. This can take a few minutes. This notice clears itself when voice setup finishes.

voice_setup_step_wyoming.title: Nova is setting up voice
voice_setup_step_wyoming.description: Step {step} of {total}: connecting Home Assistant to the voice add-ons (Wyoming). This notice clears itself when voice setup finishes.

voice_setup_step_pipeline.title: Nova is setting up voice
voice_setup_step_pipeline.description: Step {step} of {total}: creating the Nova Assist pipeline. This notice clears itself when voice setup finishes.

voice_setup_incomplete.title: Nova voice setup is incomplete
voice_setup_incomplete.description:
Nova couldn't finish setting up voice. What failed: {failed}.

To finish it by hand: in Settings → Apps, install and start Piper, Whisper and openWakeWord. Then in Settings → Voice assistants, create a pipeline with Nova as the conversation agent, Whisper for speech to text and Piper for text to speech. Nova checks again on each restart, and this notice clears itself once voice works.

retired_service.title: Nova: {service} is being retired
retired_service.description:
Something in Home Assistant, usually an automation or a script, called {service}. This service will be removed in a later Nova release. Use {replacement} instead.

This notice clears when Home Assistant restarts and comes back only if the service is called again.

retired_service_no_effect.title: Nova: {service} is being retired
retired_service_no_effect.description:
Something in Home Assistant, usually an automation or a script, called {service}. The feature behind it has been removed, so the call does nothing, and the service itself will be removed in a later Nova release. Remove the call from your automation or script.

This notice clears when Home Assistant restarts and comes back only if the service is called again.

no_entry.message: Nova is not set up. Add the Nova integration, then try again.

not_loaded.message: Nova is not loaded. Enable or reload the Nova integration, then try again.

reloading.message: Nova is starting or reloading. Try again in a moment.

setup_failed.message: Nova could not start. Check the Home Assistant log, fix the problem and reload Nova.

multiple_entries.message: More than one Nova entry is configured. Remove the extra entry, then try again.

analyze_camera.name: Analyse camera
analyze_camera.description: Takes a snapshot from a camera and has Nova describe it, out loud if wanted. When Frigate or Nest has a recent event image, that image is used instead.

prompt.name: Question
prompt.description: What Nova should look for. Leave empty for a general description.

announce.name: Speak the result
announce.description: Read the description out on the speakers. On unless switched off.

frames.name: Frames
frames.description: How many images to take. 1, the default, is a single snapshot; 2 to 6 let Nova describe what happened over a few seconds, such as someone arriving and leaving a parcel.

interval.name: Seconds between frames
interval.description: The gap between images when more than one frame is taken. Default 1.2.

analyze_on_event.name: Analyse camera after an event
analyze_on_event.description: For automations that react to a doorbell press or a person being seen. Nova waits a moment for the event image, then describes it with the reason in mind.

entity_id.name: Camera
entity_id.description: The camera the event came from.

reason.name: Reason
reason.description: What happened, for example "Doorbell pressed" or "Person detected".

conversation_summary.name: Summarise conversations
conversation_summary.description: Nova sums up recent conversations and reads the summary out.

hours.name: Hours to cover
hours.description: How far back to look. Default 24.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Only include conversations from this device. Leave empty for all.

announce.name: Speak the summary
announce.description: Read the summary out on the speakers. On unless switched off.

store.name: Save the summary
store.description: Keep the summary in the conversation store. On unless switched off.

sentinel_start.name: Start Sentinel
sentinel_start.description: Turns on Sentinel, which watches doors, locks, motion and anything unusual and speaks up when needed.

database_purge.name: Clear old conversations
database_purge.description: Deletes stored conversations older than the number of days given.

database_stats.name: Conversation store figures
database_stats.description: Counts what the conversation store holds and sends the figures as a nova_db_stats event.

briefing.name: Give a briefing
briefing.description: Nova puts together a briefing for the moment and reads it out: the time, weather, who is home, events overnight, open doors, the calendar and unusual energy use.

announce.name: Speak the briefing
announce.description: Read the briefing out on the speakers. On unless switched off.

hours.name: Hours of events
hours.description: How many hours of events to cover.

add_reminder.name: Add a reminder
add_reminder.description: Nova says the reminder at the time given. By default it waits until someone is home and stays silent in quiet hours.

label.name: Reminder
label.description: What Nova should remind you about.

trigger_at.name: When
trigger_at.description: Date and time in ISO format, for example 2026-04-17T21:00:00.

require_home.name: Only when someone is home
require_home.description: Skip the reminder when nobody is home.

respect_quiet.name: Respect quiet hours
respect_quiet.description: Hold the reminder during the household's quiet hours.

nap.name: Pause announcements
nap.description: Holds back everything except critical alerts for a while. Smoke, leaks and forced entry are still announced.

shush.name: Silence an entity or category
shush.description: Stops Nova announcing a given entity or category from now on. With nothing filled in, it silences whatever Nova has just said.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: The entity to silence, for example sensor.washer_power.

category.name: Category
category.description: One of: appliances, doors_windows, presence, energy, security, climate, lights, schedule.

all.name: Everything
all.description: Silence every announcement that is not critical until nova.unshush is used. Kept across restarts; critical safety alerts always get through.

unshush.name: Lift silencing
unshush.description: Undoes a shush. With nothing filled in, every silencing is lifted.

observer_start.name: Start the observer
observer_start.description: Turns on the observer, which notices changes around the home and speaks up about the interesting ones.

observer_status.name: Observer status
observer_status.description: Sends a nova_observer_status event with the observer's state: whether it runs, what is silenced, the last announcement and the sleep state.

create_automation.name: Create an automation
create_automation.description: Creates a Home Assistant automation from the parts given.

alias.name: Name
alias.description: A readable name for the automation.

trigger.name: Trigger
trigger.description: The trigger, in Home Assistant's format.

action.name: Action
action.description: The action, in Home Assistant's format.

diagnose_doorbell.name: Check the doorbell
diagnose_doorbell.description: Runs the doorbell checks and sends the results as an event.

test_notify.name: Test notification
test_notify.description: Sends a test push notification to the phone set up for alerts.

test_tts.name: Test the voice
test_tts.description: Plays a short Nova voice test on the broadcast speakers.

test_routing.name: Test speaker routing
test_routing.description: For diagnosis only: writes where Nova would speak to the Home Assistant log, including the voice, the broadcast target, occupied areas and each room's reply speaker. Nothing is switched or spoken.

lockdown.name: Lockdown
lockdown.description: Starts or ends lockdown. Starting it locks every lock and closes every open door. Windows already open stay as they are; a window opened during lockdown counts as a breach.

state.name: State
state.description: on starts lockdown, off ends it.

reason.name: Reason
reason.description: An optional note for the log, for example "away for the weekend".

train_doorbell_backlog.name: Learn from past doorbell events
train_doorbell_backlog.description: Looks at the Nest doorbell's stored events with Nova's vision and adds the results to the doorbell training data. Works only as far as the Nest integration makes its stored media available.

limit.name: Most events
limit.description: The most past events to look at in one run.

check_packages.name: Check for parcels and post
check_packages.description: Looks at the porch or doorbell cameras now for delivered parcels or post and announces anything new.

entity_id.name: Camera
entity_id.description: A camera to check. Leave empty to use the porch and doorbell cameras found automatically.

remember.name: Remember
remember.description: Teaches Nova a lasting fact or preference to use in conversation, for example that bin day is Tuesday. It is kept in the knowledge store and shown in the panel's Memory page.

key.name: What
key.description: The thing to remember, for example "bin day".

subject.name: About
subject.description: Whether this belongs to the household or the main resident.

ttl_seconds.name: Forget after (seconds)
ttl_seconds.description: Optional. The fact is dropped automatically after this many seconds, handy for something that only matters today.

forget.name: Forget
forget.description: Removes a stored fact, by its id or by its key, optionally only for one subject.

id.name: Fact id
id.description: The number of the fact to remove.

key.name: Key
key.description: The fact's key, for example "bin day". Used when no id is given.

subject.name: Subject
subject.description: Optional. Only match the key for this subject (household or primary).

backup.name: Back up Nova
backup.description: Saves Nova's memory, patterns, knowledge and settings to an archive in /config/nova_backups, so a rebuild or move keeps them. Download the file before rebuilding the device.

restore.name: Restore Nova
restore.description: Brings back Nova's memory, patterns, knowledge and settings from a backup archive, the newest unless one is named. Restart Home Assistant afterwards.

archive.name: Archive
archive.description: Optional. A file name in /config/nova_backups, or a full path. Defaults to the newest backup.
